frequency_question: What is the historical frequency of successful successor treaty signings within a designated deadline following the expiration or near-expiration of major water-sharing accords in the region?
membership_rule: Includes formal bilateral negotiations to replace or extend major water-sharing treaties between riparian states in South Asia. Excludes minor technical amendments or non-binding memoranda of understanding.
coverage_note: 2 named cases covering all major attempts at comprehensive water treaty renegotiation or replacement between India and Bangladesh in the modern era.
known_gaps: Excludes minor sub-basin committee meetings and non-binding joint river commission talks that did not involve replacing a landmark treaty.
skeleton: named cases representing major bilateral water treaty renegotiation attempts between India and Bangladesh since 1990
multiplier: 1 hit out of 2 major historical attempts
validity_reason: The deadline coincides with the resolution criteria date for the primary question.
